notes.title: Important Announcement - Update/Future Plans
notes.notes:
Greetings Warlords,

We come to you today with a number of things to announce.  March 28th will come with an update that should make the game more accessible and help more players enjoy the game.  The following changes will be made:

[b]•	Removal of the Kuni Shop (No ability to purchase Kuni with real money)
•	All existing cash items will be put at a 50% discount
•	Cash items will be granted to players through daily attendance and daily reward systems
•	The required materials for all crafting will be reduced
•	Warlords Awakening (The Botimos DLC/Bundle) removed from Steam Store.[/b]

Along with these changes, we have some updates as to the future plans of Warlords Awakening.  Over the past months since launching, we have attempted to increase the number of players to ensure a better experience for our players.  This has not been successful from our end and we have decided to make some key changes.

It saddens us to say that by June 28th, 2019, we will be closing the service of Warlords Awakening.  Warlords Awakening will remove all in-game purchasing moving forward as the game is set to go to a Free2Play model on May 31st.  This is being done to ensure that we can gain more users to make the game more enjoyable for everyone involved.  By discounting the cash shop items, removing in-game purchases and granting more daily rewards, we hope that everyone who ever wanted to play Warlords Awakening will have the chance

notes.title: Content Update – Dungeon Rankings, Hero’s Trail Event and more!
notes.notes:
Greetings Warlords,

Today we will be conducting a Server Maintenance in order to apply some system updates, events and hotfixes to the game.

Here are the patch notes for today:

[i]1. Preventive Server Maintenance[/i]

[b]Warlords Awakening Live Updates :[/b]

[i]2. Event “Hero’s Trail”[/i]

Leveling up new characters from 1 to 40 in order to receive rewards every 10 levels. When you create a new character, you will find in your Inventory a Lord’s Chest which can be opened once you reach level 10.

This Event will be available from September 6 to October 4 (before the maintenance).

More information on the Event [url=https://forum.warlordsawakening.com/index.php?topic=1080.0]here.[/url]

[i]3. Attendance Rewards changed.[/i]

The Attendance rewards for 2, 9, 17 and 24 days have been changed.
-	Logged in 2 Time(s): from Crystal Package to EXP Flask (25%) – 1 Day
-	Logged in 9 Time(s): from 5x Master key to 2x Master key
-	Logged in 17 times(s): from 10x Elite’s EL-Potential Scroll to 1x HP/MP Recovery Flask (50%) – 1 Day
-	Logged in 24 Times(s): from 5x Master Key to 3x Master Key

[i]4. Dungeon Ranking Board (Only Dungeons that require keys).[/i]

I. 	The Ranking Board can show the clearing time and the information of the party that cleared the Dungeon. You can only check the Top 10 ranks.
II.	 The Ranking standing will take in consideration the Time in which the Dungeon was cleared, the number of players in the party and the Mettle in general of the Party. The lesser the better.

[i]5. Repeatable quest rewards of the Philo's Alliance Board have been upgraded.[/i]

You will now receive the Red Material Box instead of selecting only one of the materials.

[i]6. Defense on Legendary armor.[/i]

The Defense Stat on Legendary armor pieces has increased significantly, Mettle will also change to 40 Mettle.

[i]7. Costs for Crafting reduced[/i]

- Crafting Legendary items LV. 25 now costs 2 Tara Spirit.
- Crafting Legendary items LV. 40 now costs 15 Gold instead of 21.
- Crafting items with the Alchemist now costs less depending on the item used to craft.

Tara Spirit Craft:
- From 1 gold with 200 Iron Ores to 1 gold 70 silver with 250 Iron Ores.
- From 2 gold with 100 Silver Ores to 1 gold 10 silver with 100 Silver Ores.
- From 3 gold with 50 Gold Ores to 80 silver with 50 Gold Ores.
- From 5 gold with 5 Hertel Ore to 50 silver with 2 Hertel Ores.

[i]8. Materials Drop probability. The drop probability for Kuntara's Hideout dungeon key materials are increased.

9. Opening the Cash Shop will automatically open the Costume\Gear Page.

10. The damage output font size has been reduced.

11. The visual effect on the Elite Lord’s transformation of the Psychic has change.[/i]

[i]12. Hall of Desctruction Bosses' HP and Attack have been increased. Techia's will now summon zombies at 49% and 19%.  Amalan's hitboxes and sizing has been improved.[/i]

The maintenance will start on September, 5th 19:00 (PDT)/ 6th 02:00 (GMT). It will take around 120 minutes.

Thank you, all our players, for your cooperation and feedback.

Warlords Awakening Team
